propositions: The `rebar metrics` subcommand must parse `--since` and `--until` date arguments and `--output json|text` format selector, then render the full metric registry over the specified date range as a single invocation
Registry hydration requires importing the `rebar.metrics` package (not just `registry` module) to trigger reader module registration side-effects before evaluating metrics

The command builds a context object carrying `repo_root`, `since`, and `until`, then calls `registry.evaluate()` for every registered `MetricSpec`, wrapping each call in exception handling to render failed metrics as unavailable

JSON output (default) must emit `{"since", "until", "metrics": {id: {lens, source, confidence, value} | {unavailable: {reason, accruing_since}}}}` for all registered metrics; text output must list one metric per line in registry order
The `metrics` command is routed via an explicit `if sub == "metrics":` dispatch arm in `_cli/__init__.py` (not a frozenset) and must be added to the `individual` frozenset in the help-coverage test
Source-level adapter isolation guard must verify that `src/rebar/_commands/metrics.py` contains no `rebar.metrics.adapters` import, ensuring portability
